name: Top Shelf Wellness
address: 205 N Phoenix Rd, STE 310, Phoenix, OR, 97535

nadir.desc: The property consists of a large commercial building with a flat roof and attached sections with shingled roofs|A paved parking lot is located in front of the structure and holds multiple vehicles|Marked parking spaces, including accessible spaces, are present|Trees and landscaping border portions of the site|The property is located in a commercial area near a major roadway interchange.

alpha.desc: The front of the facility shows the main commercial building with storefront entrances facing a paved parking lot|Multiple vehicles are parked in marked spaces|Signage is visible along the building facade|Sidewalks provide pedestrian access to the storefronts.

bravo.desc: The left side of the facility shows the side elevation of the commercial building and portions of the paved parking area|Trees and landscaping are present along this side|Additional building sections with shingled roofs are visible.

charlie.desc: The rear of the facility shows the back elevation of the commercial building|Trees and a neighboring property and building lines the rear perimeter.

delta.desc: The right side of the facility shows the side of the commercial building and paved parking areas|Multiple vehicles are parked along this elevation|Trees and landscaping continue around this side of the property.

considerations: Vehicle access is available from multiple points via the paved parking lot that surrounds the commercial building. The parking lot provides space for emergency vehicle circulation and staging. Multiple vehicles currently occupy portions of the lot. Trees and landscaping are present along the edges but do not fully obstruct access. Sidewalks support pedestrian movement along the front of the building. Neighboring commercial structures and a major roadway interchange are present in the surrounding area.
clarifications: Where are the primary vehicle entrances to the parking lot, and are any of them gated or restricted?
